dialogue.content: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いします。お時間になったら始めさせて戴います。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming today. We can get started now that it's our scheduled time.

dialogue.content: こんにちは！こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Hello! Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。初めに年齢と性別、今日の相談内容を教えていただけますか。
dialogue.English: Hello, I’m the counselor. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you’d like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: こんにちは！49歳女性です。夫の生活態度で悩んでいます。
dialogue.English: Hello! I’m a 49-year-old woman. I’m struggling with my husband’s lifestyle and behavior.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。パートナーさんのことで悩んでいらっしゃるのですね。例えばどんなことでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Thank you. It sounds like you're concerned about your partner. Could you share some examples?

dialogue.content: はい。夫が酷い生活をしていて毎日ダラダラ、、見ていて嫌になります。。
dialogue.English: Yes. My husband has a terrible lifestyle; he just lazes around every day, and it's become upsetting to watch.

dialogue.content: 仕事はほぼオンラインです
dialogue.English: His work is almost entirely online.

dialogue.content: ずっと家にいらっしゃるのですね。そうなると、いろいろ目について嫌になることもあるかもしれませんね。あなたも家にいらっしゃるのですか。
dialogue.English: So he's always at home. In that case, I can imagine you might notice many things that bother you. Are you also at home?

dialogue.content: 私は自営業なので仕事で出ることも多々ありますが、自宅で仕事の場合も多いです。
dialogue.English: I’m self-employed, so I often go out for work, but I also work from home a lot.

dialogue.content: 目について本当にイライラします
dialogue.English: It really irritates me when I see it.

dialogue.content: ご自身がお仕事をしていらっしゃると、なおさらだらだらされるとイライラもしますね。パートナーさんはオンラインということでしたが、時間的にも融通が利く感じでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Since you are working yourself, I can see how it would be especially irritating to see him lazing around. You mentioned his work is online; does he have a flexible schedule?

dialogue.content: そうなんです💦夫の時間については、フレックスなので比較的融通がききます。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. His work is on a flex-time basis, so his schedule is quite flexible.

dialogue.content: 時間的にも融通がきくとなると、見ている側としては、何やってるのかしら、という感じにもなるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: With that kind of flexibility, I can see how from your perspective, you might end up wondering what he's actually doing all day.

dialogue.content: はい‥しかも酷い時は午前中からお酒を飲み出します。。
dialogue.English: Yes... and on bad days, he starts drinking in the morning.

dialogue.content: 仕事中もずっとベッドの上でダラダラ適当な感じに見えてしまいます。。
dialogue.English: Even while he's supposed to be working, it just looks like he's lazing about carelessly in bed all the time.

dialogue.content: それは、なかなかですね。仕事には支障をきたさないということなのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: That sounds very challenging. Does it not interfere with his work?

dialogue.content: 支障をきたしてないと信じたいのですが、私には話さないので詳細は分かりません、、
dialogue.English: I want to believe it doesn't interfere with his work, but he doesn't talk to me about it, so I don't know the details.

dialogue.content: お給料をいただけるだけ有り難いと思ってしまいます
dialogue.English: I find myself just being grateful that he's still getting paid.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。オンラインのお仕事にもいろいろありますが、相手側には見えないで大丈夫なお仕事なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. There are many kinds of online jobs, so his must be one where the people on the other end don't need to see him.

dialogue.content: はい。会議なども顔出し無しで音声のみなので、顔が赤くても問題なく仕事になるようです。。
dialogue.English: Yes. Meetings and such are audio-only, with no video requirement, so it seems he can work without any problems even if his face is flushed from drinking.

dialogue.content: とはいえ、泥酔して会議中に寝ている日もあります💦
dialogue.English: That said, there are days when he gets dead drunk and falls asleep during a meeting.

dialogue.content: 午後なのに
dialogue.English: Even in the afternoon.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか。それは大丈夫なのかしらという気になりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. That does make you wonder whether he's really okay.

dialogue.content: はい、仕事も、体も大丈夫なの？と感じてます
dialogue.English: Yes, I worry whether his job and his health are okay.

dialogue.content: 子どもらも呆れています
dialogue.English: Our children are fed up with it, too.

dialogue.content: お子さんにもみられているのですね。そのようなご様子についてパートナーさんに何かお話はされたことはありますか。
dialogue.English: So the children are witnessing this as well. Have you talked to your partner about this behavior?

dialogue.content: はい、子どもも家のパパは普通じゃない、と思っているようです。夫にも度々飲み出す時間を遅くするとか、生活態度改善をお願いしましたが全く変わりません。
dialogue.English: Yes, the kids seem to think their dad at home isn’t normal. I’ve repeatedly asked my husband to start drinking later in the day and improve his habits, but he hasn't changed at all.

dialogue.content: お話しされても、聞いてもらえないのですね。体のことも心配していっているのに、ちょっと寂しいですね。お仕事の状況はこの先も変わらなさそうですか。
dialogue.English: So he doesn't listen, even when you bring it up. It must be disheartening, especially when you're expressing concern for his health. Do you think his work situation is likely to change going forward?

dialogue.content: はい、家族を大切に思わないのかな？と悲しくなります。仕事はあと数年はこのままかな？と思います。とはいえ、50代なので定年も近付いてきてどうなるのか不安です。
dialogue.English: Yes, it makes me sad, and I wonder if he even cares about the family. I think his work will stay like this for a few more years. That said, he’s in his 50s and retirement is approaching, so I’m anxious about what will happen.

dialogue.content: そうですか。家族が心配しているということをわかってほしいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. You just want him to understand that his family is worried about him.

dialogue.content: はい。夫は俺は大丈夫だ、の一点張りで家族の迷惑は考えないようです。
dialogue.English: Yes. He keeps insisting, “I’m fine,” and doesn’t seem to consider how it affects the family.

dialogue.content: ご家族としては、いろいろご心配だとは思いますが、このまま家で仕事を続けるとなると、どうしてほしいとお考えですか。一番気になることは？
dialogue.English: I understand you have many concerns as a family, but if he's going to continue working from home this way, what would you like to see change? What is your biggest concern?

dialogue.content: 一番気になるのは、子どもへの影響です。
dialogue.English: My biggest concern is the effect it has on our children.

dialogue.content: 酔って暴言が多々あったり冷静な判断が出来なかったり
dialogue.English: He's often verbally abusive when drunk and is incapable of sound judgment.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お酒が一番の問題と考えてよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see. Is it fair to say that alcohol is the main issue?

dialogue.content: 親としては子ども達には反面教師にして欲しいですが、一日中ダラダラしている姿を息子が真似してしまい困っています。
dialogue.English: As a parent, I wish the children would just see him as a negative role model, but I'm troubled because our son has started to imitate his habit of lazing around all day.

dialogue.content: はい、お酒による生活の乱れが大きいと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I believe the disruption to his life caused by the drinking is the main problem.

dialogue.content: 息子さんへの影響も心配なところですが、それも含めて、お酒の飲み方を考えてもらえるといいですね。
dialogue.English: The effect on your son is certainly a concern, and taking that into account, it would be ideal if your husband could reconsider his drinking habits.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね。長年伝えていますが、全く聞き入れません、、、どうしたら良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Exactly. I've been telling him for years, but he won't listen at all. What should I do?

dialogue.content: 聞き入れてもらえないというのは、悲しいですね。お体の心配、お子さんへの影響など、酔っていないときに冷静にお話はできそうですか。
dialogue.English: It's disheartening that he won't listen. Do you think it would be possible to have a calm conversation with him when he's sober about your concerns for his health and the impact on the children?

dialogue.content: はい、もう何百回も伝えていますが、俺は変わらない、このままだ…とばかりです。酔ってない時は寝ている時と少しの時間なのでなかなか難しいですが、挑戦は出来ると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I've told him hundreds of times, but all he says is, 'I'm not going to change, this is just how I am.' The only times he's sober are when he's asleep or for very short periods, which makes it difficult, but I believe I can try.

dialogue.content: ただ、冷静に話せるか、、が課題です
dialogue.English: The challenge, however, is whether I can remain calm.

dialogue.content: 酔っていないときが少しの時間しかないというのも、心配ですね。
dialogue.English: The fact that there's only a very short window when he's sober is also a concern.

dialogue.content: 夫は物凄く気難しく、短気です。
dialogue.English: My husband is extremely difficult and short-tempered.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、本当によく体が持ってると思います
dialogue.English: Yes… I’m honestly amazed his body is holding up.

dialogue.content: そうですか、なかなかの強敵ですね。冷静にというのは、なかなか忍耐のいることですが、そういう相手だと、売り言葉に買い言葉になりそうですから、努めて静かにが大切だと感じますが、いかがでしょう。
dialogue.English: I see, he sounds like a very challenging person. It takes a lot of patience to remain calm, but with someone like that, it's easy for one harsh word to lead to another. I feel it's important to try your best to stay composed. What do you think?

dialogue.content: はい、おっしゃる通りです。私がヒートアップしてしまうと夫は巻き舌で捲し立ててくるので、努めて冷静に…ですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, you're absolutely right. If I get heated, my husband will just rail at me angrily, so I must make an effort to remain calm.

dialogue.content: なかなか難しいですが、肝に銘じてやるしかないですね
dialogue.English: It's very difficult, but I know I just have to take it to heart and do it.

dialogue.content: はい、なかなか大変だとは思いますが。あと、物理的に身の回りからアルコール類をへらしてみる　というのはどうでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand it must be very difficult. Another idea, what about physically reducing the amount of alcohol in his immediate surroundings?

dialogue.content: アルコールについては捨てようものなら凄い剣幕で怒り出すので夫が買ってきたものはなかなか減らせない状態です。常に自室にウイスキーの瓶がありそれを飲んでいます
dialogue.English: As for alcohol, if I try to throw anything away, he flies into a rage, so I can hardly reduce what he buys. He always has a bottle of whiskey in his room and drinks that.

dialogue.content: ご自分で準備もしていらっしゃるのですね。それはなかなか手出しは難しそうですね。自室という言葉が出ましたが、では、お仕事もそちらでしていらっしゃるのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: So he buys it himself. That does sound difficult to interfere with. You mentioned he has his own room; is that where he works, too?

dialogue.content: はい、仕事自室です。いつもこもっています。
dialogue.English: Yes, he works in his own room. He’s always holed up in there.

dialogue.content: 仕事も自室です。でした
dialogue.English: I mean, he works in his room.

dialogue.content: はい、ちゃんと伝わっていますよ。そうなると、お子さんやあなたは見ないようにしようと思えば、お仕事の様子は見なくて済むということでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understood what you meant. In that case, does that mean that if you and the children wanted to, you could avoid seeing him while he's working?

dialogue.content: 狭い家なので、見えてしまう…というのが現状です💦あとはとにかくベッドでダラダラ、散らかし放題、、家事の手伝いもしてくれないのでその態度に嫌気が指しています。
dialogue.English: It's a small house, so we end up seeing him anyway... that's the current situation. Plus, he's just always lazing around in bed, leaving messes everywhere, and he doesn't help with any chores. I'm just sick of his attitude.

dialogue.content: そうですね、声も出されるということでしたから、気になってしまいますよね。あれこれ、気になることはあるとは思いますが、まずは一番気なるお酒のところにしぼってお話しされてみてはいかがでしょう。
dialogue.English: I see. And you mentioned you can hear him, so it would be hard to ignore. I understand there are many things that bother you, but perhaps you could try focusing the conversation specifically on the drinking, as it's your biggest concern?

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes…

dialogue.content: お話を聞いていると、あなたはずいぶん長い間、いろいろ心配しながら我慢していらっしゃったのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: Listening to your story, it sounds like you've been worrying and patiently putting up with this for a very long time.

dialogue.content: はい、自分でもそう思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so too.

dialogue.content: ちょっと腹の立つこともあるかもしれませんが、心配しているという気持ちをしっかり伝えてみてはいかがでしょう。
dialogue.English: It may be frustrating at times, but what if you try to clearly convey that your feelings are coming from a place of concern?

dialogue.content: そうですね。夫を思い心配しているところにだけフォーカスして話すのは有効かもしれません。
dialogue.English: You're right. It might be effective to focus solely on conveying that I care about him and am worried.

dialogue.content: パートナーさんは、俺は大丈夫と言っていらっしゃるとのことでしたが、そういうときって、もしかしたら自分でも少しふあんがあるのかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: You said your partner insists that he's fine, but sometimes when people say that, it might be because they are feeling a bit insecure themselves.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね…
dialogue.English: Do you think so...?

dialogue.content: お酒に頼っているとは感じています
dialogue.English: I do feel he’s relying on alcohol.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、そういう不安も話してもらえると、こちらも対処の仕方が変わってくるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. If he were able to talk about those anxieties, it might change how you could approach the situation as well.

dialogue.content: ストレスは抱えやすい人なので紛らわすために飲むことが癖になっているのかな？と感じています。なかなか不安を話すタイプではないのですが、話してもらうコツなどあるでしょうか？？
dialogue.English: He's a person who gets stressed easily, so I feel that drinking to escape has become a habit. He's not the type to talk about his anxieties. Are there any tips for getting him to open up?

dialogue.content: 今までの様子や私との関わりでは、とても話しそうにありません💦
dialogue.English: Based on his past behavior and our interactions, it seems very unlikely that he would talk.

dialogue.content: これは聞いた話ですが、こちらから相手に興味を持って相手の話を聞くと、相手もこちらに興味を持って聞いてくれるということがあるそうです。会話の減ってきた熟年夫婦の例ですが。
dialogue.English: This is something I heard in the context of a long-married couple who had stopped talking much, but apparently, if you show genuine interest in the other person and listen to them, they will become interested in listening to you in return.

dialogue.content: なるほど、私の関わりをまずは変えて行くことが大事ですね！
dialogue.English: I see, so the important thing is for me to first change the way I interact with him!

dialogue.content: 長年過ごしてきた夫婦だからこそ、なかなか難しいこともあるとは思いますが、それも相手を思ってのことですから、きっと通じるものはあると思います。
dialogue.English: I know it can be difficult, precisely because you've been married for so long, but since your actions come from a place of care for him, I believe you will be able to get through to him.

dialogue.content: そうですね。通じると信じて関わるしかないですね！やってみたいと思います！！
dialogue.English: You're right. I just have to engage with him and believe that I can get through. I'm going to try it!

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間となってしまいました。あなたの家族を思う気持ちが、パートナーさんに通じて、少しでも状況が改善されていくことを願っています。また何かありましたらいつでも相談にいらしてください。
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is almost up. I hope your feelings of concern for your family get through to your partner and that the situation improves, even a little. Please feel free to make another appointment anytime if you need to talk again.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。また機会がありましたら宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much. I will definitely do so if the need arises again.

dialogue.content: はい、いつでもお待ちしています。今日はこれで終了とさせていただきます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, we are always here for you. That concludes our session for today. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい、こちらこそありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you as well!
